license.installation_id_help: Not a secret: the store needs it to bind your license to this installation.

license.offline.help: Generate the request code, paste it at the store's offline page on any connected device, then import the returned file here.
license.deactivate.confirm: Deactivate this installation's license? You can activate the key on another install afterwards.
license.hub_error: Last answer from the license hub

review.title: Review
review.shortcuts: Shortcuts: A approve · R reject · N request info · S save · J/K next/previous field · Esc back
review.no_preview: No page preview for this file type.
review.note_placeholder: Internal note (not visible to the client)
review.not_processed: This document has not been processed yet.

settings.pipeline.title: Processing settings
settings.pipeline.auto_approve: Auto-approve documents that pass every check above the threshold
settings.pipeline.policy.local_first_clo: Local first, cloud fallback for uncertain documents
settings.pipeline.cloud_opt_in: Allow cloud AI for this firm (requires the Cloud AI plan feature)
users.title: Users
users.name: Name
intake.paused: Your accountant's InvoiceFlow subscription is paused. Existing documents stay available.
common.name: Name
common.confirm_delete: Delete this item? This cannot be undone.
exports.title: Exports
exports.paused: New exports need an active InvoiceFlow subscription. Exports made before stay downloadable.
templates.title: Export templates
templates.help: Define the columns, their order and headers once per client and reuse them for CSV, Excel and DATEV exports.
templates.empty: No templates yet. The default column set is used.
apikeys.title: API keys
apikeys.help: Keys give external systems (n8n, your own software) access to the public API. The plan must include the API feature.
apikeys.revoke.confirm: Revoke this key? Every integration using it stops working at once.
apikeys.created: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.help: InvoiceFlow POSTs signed JSON events to your URL. Verify the X-InvoiceFlow-Signature header with the endpoint secret.
webhooks.created: Copy the signing secret now. It is shown only once.
channels.title: Channels
channels.help: Clients send invoices by email, Telegram or WhatsApp. Every sender must be mapped to a client company; unknown senders land in quarantine.
channels.not_entitled: Messaging channels are not part of this plan; documents sent by email, Telegram or WhatsApp are answered with an intake-paused message.
channels.identity.hint: Phone numbers in international format, e.g. +49 151 1234567.
channels.pairing.title: Pairing code
channels.pairing.help: Give the client a code; they send it to the bot once and their number is linked automatically. Codes expire after 7 days.
channels.pairing.instructions: Ask the client to send "{code}" to the {channel} bot (Telegram: /start {code}).
quarantine.title: Quarantined: unknown sender {sender}. Release it to a client to process it, or discard it.
clients.accept_any.hint: Off: only mapped senders; others are quarantined.
my.title: My documents
my.empty: No documents yet. Upload an invoice or take a photo.
my.open_questions: Your accountant has {n} question(s) for you.
my.comment.question: Question
capture.no_camera: The camera is not available. Use Upload instead.
capture.hint.blurry: Hold still: the image is blurry
capture.hint.glare: Glare: tilt away from the light
capture.hint.cut_off: Move back: the edges are cut off
offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Your documents will show again as soon as you are connected. Uploads need a connection.
login.sso: Sign in with your company account (SSO)
login.sso_failed: Single sign-on failed ({reason}). Ask your firm owner, or sign in with your password.
sso.title: Single sign-on (OpenID Connect)
sso.help: Staff sign in with your identity provider (Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace, Keycloak…). Register the callback URL below as the redirect URI of a confidential client with PKCE.
sso.not_entitled: Single sign-on is not part of this plan.
sso.secret_stored: A secret is stored; leave empty to keep it.
sso.provisioning.invited_only: Only invited users may sign in (recommended)
sso.provisioning.auto: Create staff users on first sign-in
clients.dsr.erase.confirm: Request erasure for this client's documents? Documents under tax retention are restricted now and deleted when their period ends.
connectors.title: Accounting connectors
connectors.help: Send approved invoices to your accounting software. Secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.
connectors.not_entitled: Connectors are not part of this plan.
connectors.secret_stored: A value is stored; leave empty to keep it.
connectors.test_failed: Connection failed; see the message above.
settings.pipeline.cloud_cap: Cloud AI calls per month (0 = unlimited)
settings.pipeline.cloud_cap.hint: Once reached, documents stay with the local extraction until next month.
clients.peppol_id.hint: Participant id (scheme:id) for receiving through the Peppol network.
clients.tax_number.hint: NIP (Poland) or SIREN (France) for KSeF / platform routing.
license.addons.hint: Channels, connectors and cloud AI can be added to this license; refresh the license after buying.
connectors.clients.help: This network identifies each client company separately; enter the credentials per client.
connectors.routing: Documents are routed to the client company whose {field} matches the receiver.
bank.title: Bank reconciliation
bank.help: Import CAMT.053 or MT940 statements or link a bank feed; payments are matched to invoices and confirmed here.
bank.import.done: {n} new transactions ({d} already known): {m} matched automatically, {s} suggestions.
bank.feed.help: Link accounts through GoCardless Bank Account Data; transactions are pulled daily.
reporting.title: Digital reporting (ViDA)
reporting.help: Intra-EU B2B invoices per client and period in the ViDA DRR data set (EN 16931 subset). Submission goes through the configured transport; today the report is kept in the archive.
engines.title: Reading engines
engines.help: What reads documents on this installation. Local engines run on this server; cloud engines are used only with the Cloud AI plan feature, your opt-in above and a policy other than local-only, and every call is logged.
engines.tier1.value: PDF text layer, e-invoice parsers, rules
engines.no_renderer: no page renderer: scanned PDFs cannot be read
engines.footer: Engines are chosen by the operator (OCR_ENGINE, LOCAL_LLM, CLOUD_PROVIDER, OCR_CLOUD in the server environment); see the operations guide.
license.banner.core_not_included: This license does not include InvoiceFlow (its core tool). Ask whoever issued it to add the core tool, or buy InvoiceFlow in the store. Intake and processing are paused; your data stays available.
license.refresh.next: The next check is possible at {time}.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, you get a link to choose a new password. The link works for 15 minutes.
link.invalid: This link has expired or was already used.
mfa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: Two-factor authentication is required for every account. You need an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis).
mfa.step1: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code.
mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand
mfa.codes_intro: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now: download or copy them and keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
password.hint: At least 12 characters, letters mixed with other characters.
platform.title: Platform
platform.acting_banner: You are working in {firm} as platform admin. Every action is in this firm's audit log.
platform.max_firms_hint: Firms in use / firms allowed by the platform license.
platform.license_hint: Only the number of firms. Without it the platform runs one firm.
platform.license_intro: The platform license raises the number of firms. It is issued by 21CEL on request and cannot be bought in the store. Each firm still needs its own InvoiceFlow license.
platform.created_sent: The firm was created. An invite was sent to {email}.
platform.created_link: The firm was created. Send this invite link to {email}:
platform.full: This platform allows {n} firm(s). More firms need a platform license from 21CEL.
platform.license_key_optional: License key (optional for the first firm)
platform.license_key_required: License key of the new firm
platform.firm.name: Firm
platform.firm.delete_body: The firm's users are locked out at once; its data is erased after 30 days. A backup younger than 24 hours is required.
reason.label: Justification
reason.hint: Required. It is kept in the audit log.
setup.title: Set up InvoiceFlow
setup.intro: This creates the platform admin. The admin creates firms and can open any firm for setup and support.
setup.code_hint: Shown in the server log at the first start (docker compose logs api).
setup.done: This installation is already set up.
users.invite_intro: The person gets an email with a link to set their password and two-factor authentication. You can also copy the link and send it yourself.
users.link_intro: Link for {email}, valid until {date}. It works once.
users.reset_sent: A password reset link was created.
users.deleted_intro: History shows these people as placeholders. Only the firm owner can see who they were; it is erased after the retention period.
clients.intake: Intake per channel (click to pause or resume)
clients.regenerate_body: The client company gets a new address; all its data stays. The old address is never handed out again. During {days} grace day(s) it still accepts known senders (flagged); after that, mail to it is dropped and logged.
domain.root_intro: The domain this installation runs under (for example 21cel.com). Each firm gets an inbound subdomain under it, like x7k2.21cel.com. Verify it with the TXT record below and point an MX record (or a wildcard *.domain) to your mail server, with a catch-all into the IMAP mailbox.
domain.change_root: Change the platform domain (all firm subdomains move)
domain.firm_intro: Your client companies get addresses on this domain. The platform subdomain works at once; your own domain becomes the default once its TXT record is verified.
domain.legacy: No platform domain is set yet; addresses use {domain}.
domain.grace_hint: 0-14. During the grace period old addresses accept known senders only.
domain.txt_intro: Create this TXT record at your DNS provider, then press Check.
domain.warning: The TXT record is gone. Mail keeps arriving; add the record again.
settings.smtp_intro: Used for invites, password resets and questions to clients. Firms use this unless they set their own.
settings.firm_smtp_intro: Leave empty to use the platform's mail server, or set your own.
settings.imap_intro: The catch-all mailbox the app reads every minute. Firms use this unless they set their own.
settings.firm_imap_intro: Only when your own domain delivers into your own mailbox.
settings.inbound_webhook_intro: The bearer token your mail provider sends to /api/v1/channels/email/inbound (alternative to IMAP).
settings.ai_intro: Local and cloud models for extraction. Changes apply to the next document; cloud AI still needs the firm's opt-in and the license.
bots.title: Own bots and numbers
bots.intro: Without an own bot, the platform's Telegram bot and WhatsApp number are used. Add your firm's own bot, or one dedicated to a single client company: everything it receives then belongs to that client company.
bots.token_hint: From @BotFather (/newbot). Stored encrypted; the webhook is set up automatically.
bots.webhook_failed: The bot was saved but Telegram did not accept the webhook (the app must be reachable over HTTPS).
bots.whatsapp_setup: In Meta → WhatsApp → Configuration, set this callback URL and verify token (shown only now):
bots.howto: Telegram groups and channels: how to set them up
bots.howto1: Create a group (or channel) per client company, for example "Acme – Invoices".
bots.howto2: Add the bot and make it an administrator. Bots that are not admins only see commands in groups (privacy mode); in channels a bot must be an admin.
bots.howto3: Create a pairing code for the client company and post "/pair CODE" in the group once.
bots.howto4: From then on everything posted in the group goes to that client company. Tick "members only" to accept files only from paired people.
trash.confirm_body: {n} document(s) will go to the trash; {p} are bookkeeping records (approved, exported, pushed or network invoices) and stay where they are.
trash.needs_approval: More than 5 documents: a firm owner has to approve this.
trash.requested: Request sent: a firm owner has to approve it.
trash.intro: Documents stay in the trash for the firm's trash retention (30 days by default) and can be restored until then. Every action is in the audit log with its justification.
scope.all: All client companies of the firm
apikeys.cidrs_hint: Addresses or networks, separated by commas. Empty = any address.
backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Encrypted archives of all data, files, settings and logs. Each backup has its own password: it can be shown 5 times, each time with a fresh code from your authenticator app. Save it, or set up a recovery key that opens every backup.
backups.code_hint: Needed to show a password or to restore.
backups.password_shown: Save this password now. It can be shown {n} more time(s).
backups.restore_body: The current state is backed up first, then replaced by this backup. Everyone is signed out.
backups.restore_started: The restore ran. Check the result below.
backups.not_saved: No backup password has been saved and no recovery key is confirmed. If this server is lost, the backups cannot be opened. Show a password and keep it safe, or create a recovery key.
backups.recovery_intro: A key that opens every backup made after it, without the password (also with the standard age tool: age -d -i key.txt). Only you keep it; the server stores only its public part.
backups.settings_intro: target: storage (the built-in MinIO or the document storage) or s3; schedule: daily, weekly or off; hour in UTC; how many daily, weekly and monthly backups to keep; object lock days for S3.
backups.restore_firm: Restore a firm from a file
backups.restore_firm_intro: For a firm from another server, or a firm shown as missing data after a platform restore. An existing firm is backed up first.
setup.restored: The platform was restored. Sign in with the platform admin account from the backup; then restore each firm from its own backup.
